# partiteai_embedding_profile (Resource)

An embedding profile: the model a memory store writes its vectors with.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `configuration` (Attributes) The embedding model and how it is asked for vectors. Which settings a model accepts is the provider's business, not a fixed shape per vendor, so this is one block for every provider. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--configuration))
- `model_provider_id` (String) ID of the model provider this profile belongs to
- `name` (String) Resource name

### Optional

> **NOTE**: [Write-only arguments](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/resources/ephemeral#write-only-arguments) are supported in Terraform 1.11 and later.

- `description` (String) Resource description
- `probe` (Boolean, [Write-only](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/resources/ephemeral#write-only-arguments)) Whether the server sends one request to the provider before each create or update, and refuses a profile the provider rejects. An unreachable provider does not fail the write. Defaults to false.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) Timestamp when the resource was created
- `dimensions` (Number) The width of the vectors this profile produces. A memory store keeps every vector of one width together, so changing it means re-embedding what the store already holds.
- `id` (String) Resource identifier
- `updated_at` (String) Timestamp when the resource was last updated

<a id="nestedatt--configuration"></a>
### Nested Schema for `configuration`

Required:

- `dimensions` (Number) The width of the vectors this profile produces
- `model` (String) The name the service knows the embedding model by, such as text-embedding-3-small or gemini-embedding-001

Optional:

- `send_dimensions` (Boolean) Ask the service for that width with each request. Set it only for a model that can be asked for fewer dimensions than it produces by default.
- `task_type` (String) What the embedding is for, such as RETRIEVAL_DOCUMENT. Google and the Cohere models on Amazon Bedrock accept it.
